title: Annual rate of sperm count decline, before vs after 2000 (percent per year)

source.name: Temporal trends in sperm count (Levine et al., meta-analysis)

notes: The same meta-analysis found the annual rate of decline roughly doubled after 2000: about 1.16% a year from 1973-2000, accelerating to about 2.64% a year from 2000-2018.
